function.name: grep
function.description: Search the entire corpus for a regex pattern. Returns every matching line with line numbers and total match count. Complements search() which ranks by relevance — grep scans exhaustively.

pattern.description: Regex pattern (e.g. "\bshor\b" for whole-word, "hidden_secret" for literal)

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read content from a file at specific line ranges. Use startLine/endLine from search results.

function.name: search
function.description: Search the knowledge base. Returns sections ranked by relevance with line ranges for read_file.

function.name: search_documents
function.description: Search the attached documents. Returns passages ranked by relevance, each with its document, line range and pages for read_document. Pass `document` to search one document only.

document.description: Document id or title, to search one document only

function.name: read_document
function.description: Read the exact text of an attached document: a whole page, or a line range from search results. Name the document by id or title.

document.description: Document id or title, from search results or the briefing

page.description: Page number — returns every section that touches the page

function.name: view_page
function.description: Look at a page of an attached document as an image — for a table, chart or figure, after reading the text around it. `figure` picks one figure on the page by its number.

page.description: Page number, from search or read_document results

figure.description: Which figure on the page (1 = first), to view just the figure
